items.title: Live: David Littleproud steps down as Nationals leader, coy on who should replace him
items.description: David Littleproud has announced he's stepping down as Nationals leader in a shock announcement saying he believes it's time to transition to a new leader. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Police escort Iranian women's football team to airport amid protests
items.description: Members of the Iranian women's football team have been escorted by police to Gold Coast Airport amid chants of "save our girls" from protesters. Follow live.

items.title: How a daring escape by Iranian soccer players secured their asylum in Australia
items.description: Australian officials waited on the sidelines of the Iranian football team's final game in the Gold Coast on Sunday, signalling to players help was available if they wanted to talk. The government has granted asylum to five athletes who escaped from their hotel with assistance from Australian Federal Police.

items.title: What is a Wedgetail, the powerful aircraft Australia is sending to war?
items.description: One of Australia's most sophisticated military surveillance planes will be deployed to the Middle East, along with a crew of about 85 defence personnel to operate it.

items.title: Government seeks power to temporarily ban some people from Australia
items.description: Overseas visitors planning to travel from certain countries could be temporarily blocked from entering Australia in an attempt by the federal government to stop a wave of people overstaying their visas due to the war in the Middle East.

items.title: Live: Bundaberg residents told to 'leave immediately' as floodwaters rise, bridges to shut
items.description: A major flood is threatening Bundaberg after days of rain spilled dams and set rivers on the rise across Queensland.

items.title: 'Unprepared' to defend against Iranian drones, US calls on Ukraine for help
items.description: Ukraine is called upon to provide drone defence expertise to the US and Gulf states as the region struggles to counter swarms of Iranian attack drones.

items.title: In the early hours of the Iran war, Indonesia's president made a telling offer
items.description: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's big ambitions on the world stage and at home have alarmed his critics.

items.title: Breaking: Kyle Sandilands insists he is 'not in breach' of $100m radio contract
items.description: Kyle Sandilands has argued he is not in breach of his $100 million contract with ARN Media after being taken off air for "an act of serious misconduct" on his and Jackie "O" Henderson's hit radio show.

items.title: Court orders Linda Reynolds and Commonwealth to enter mediation
items.description: The Federal Court orders mediation between former WA senator Linda Reynolds and the Commonwealth in her legal claim over its conduct during a financial settlement with Brittany Higgins.

items.title: Family of 14yo says Aidan Becker 'risked his life to save our son'
items.description: The family of a 14-year-old boy allegedly attacked in Mernda last week said Aidan Becker, who was fatally stabbed trying to protect the teenager, showed "extraordinary courage and compassion in risking his life to save our son".

items.title: Prosecutors launch search of Epstein's former New Mexico Zorro Ranch
items.description: New Mexico state investigators search a secluded ranch where financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein once entertained guests amid allegations that the property may have been used for sexual abuse and sex trafficking of young women.

items.title: Live: ASX rises after heavy sell-off as oil prices moderate
items.description: The Australian market is tracking higher after Wall Street's overnight rise. The ASX 200 is up 1.5 per cent, regaining some of yesterday's losses, spurred by concerns about the impact of the Middle East war. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: How petrol price panic is unfolding across Asia
items.description: From closing schools to daily limits, the surging cost of oil prompts countries across Asia to take action to ensure fuel supply and keep prices in check.

items.title: The five practices I always return to deal with anxiety
items.description: No-one is harder on me than me. Anxiety thrives on this. Along the way, I've built a toolkit that helps me regulate, reconnect and come back to myself.

items.title: Pilbara artist's work taken on 5,000km road trip for Sydney show
items.description: From the Pilbara to Penrith, an Indigenous WA community has taken its prized cultural and artistic possessions across the country for the Biennale of Sydney.

items.title: ABC Shakespeare quiz: How well doest thou know his characters and quotes?
items.description: A quiz by any other word would smell as sweet, or something, so have a crack at our 10 questions on the works of William Shakespeare.

items.title: Government warned now-closed 'horse and cart' Convict Bridge unfit for modern traffic
items.description: The Blue Mountains community warned the NSW government the Great Western Highway's historic Convict Bridge could not withstand modern day traffic prior to its closure last week.

items.title: Teenager appeals 16-year sentence for murder of Vyleen White
items.description: The 17-year-old boy, who cannot legally be named, pleaded guilty to Vyleen White's murder and several other offences last year.

items.title: Plan for thousands of new homes at 'one of Sydney's most vibrant areas'
items.description: The NSW government on Tuesday unveiled plans to rezone the 113-hectare Burwood North precinct, positioning it as a residential hub between Sydney's CBD and Parramatta.

items.title: Labor to pass super tax changes with support of Greens
items.description: The legislation comes as speculation builds that the federal government will pursue more ambitious tax changes in the May budget.

items.title: Boil water alert issued for Darwin after pumping failure at main drinking supply
items.description: The NT health department has issued a boil water alert for Darwin, after problems with the pump station at Darwin River Dam caused by flash flooding.

items.title: Minns says troubled $3.1bn motorway may not open while he's premier
items.description: NSW Premier Chris Minns says he does not know if the troubled M6 motorway will open while he is still in power.

items.title: No regrets for Lomax as rugby 'novice' begins union journey
items.description: Rugby recruit Zac Lomax knows he has a long way to go to fulfil his dream of becoming a dual international and playing for the Wallabies at the 2027 World Cup.

items.title: Holiday town asked to prove it has a homelessness problem
items.description: While local families are left living in tents and caravans, authorities tell Margaret River's leaders they need to present more data detailing the holiday town's growing homelessness problem.
